root_cause: Systematic overcharging on RuPay Credit on UPI transactions resulting in an excess fee leak across 4 transactions.
diagnosis: The acquirer is applying a higher MDR than expected for RuPay Credit on UPI transactions, resulting in a total leakage of Rs 189.53. Note that this comparison relies on an illustrative modeled benchmark.
action_rationale: Requesting a refund for the overcharged MDR is the direct mechanism to recover the Rs 189.53 in excess fees deducted by the acquirer.
